en.sayed-ali-raza: do not commit the crime of opposing me, do not be seduced into disobeying me and do not wing at each other with eyes when you hear me.
By Allāh, Who germinates the seed and blows the wind, whatever I convey to you is from the Prophet. Neither the conveyor (of Allāh’s message, i.e. the Prophet) lied nor the hearer misunderstood.
